features.name: age_zscore
features.description: Standardized age using training mean and std for scale-normalized distance.
features.expected_model_benefit: Brings age onto unit scale so it contributes proportionally in Euclidean neighborhoods.

features.name: duration_log_zscore
features.description: Log-transformed and standardized call duration to compress heavy tail before distance computation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces dominance of long-duration outliers in distance metrics.

features.name: campaign_log_zscore
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes skewed contact frequencies for stable neighbor distances.

features.name: euribor_zscore
features.description: Standardized euribor3m rate for macro-economic similarity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Equalizes contribution of interest rate signal in distance calculations.

features.name: macro_composite_index
features.description: Composite macroeconomic similarity score combining standardized employment, rate, and confidence indicators.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single low-dimensional axis capturing economic regime for neighborhood matching.

features.name: not_previously_contacted
features.description: Indicator that the client was never previously contacted (pdays sentinel 999).
features.expected_model_benefit: Separates fresh contacts from re-contacts as a clean cluster split in neighbor space.

features.name: pdays_recency_score
features.description: Recency score: small if recently contacted, zero if never contacted.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes recency on a bounded scale suitable for distance metrics, masking the 999 sentinel.

features.name: contact_intensity
features.description: Ratio of current campaign contacts to total prior contacts plus one, capturing engagement intensity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Highlights heavily contacted clients clustering similarly in neighbor space.

features.name: age_band_indicator
features.description: Coarse age cluster index: young (<30)=0, prime (30-50)=1, senior (50-65)=2, retired (>65)=3.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides discrete demographic cluster useful for KNN tie-breaking.

features.name: economic_stress_distance
features.description: Distance from median economic conditions using standardized emp.var.rate and cons.conf.idx.
features.expected_model_benefit: Unsupervised prototype distance highlighting unusual economic contexts.

features.name: client_risk_profile
features.description: Semantic ordinal score of client financial risk combining default, housing loan, and personal loan status, where higher values indicate more financial obligations/risk.
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a semantically meaningful axis for grouping financially similar clients in KNN space.

features.name: contactability_quality
features.description: Semantic assessment of the quality/reachability of the contact channel and timing, considering contact type, month, and day_of_week patterns typical for outreach effectiveness.
features.expected_model_benefit: Embeds domain knowledge about communication channel effectiveness into the distance space.
